dedupe_keys.name: workforce management information office of rail regulation

description: Workforce Management Information - Office of Rail Regulation is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Office of Rail and Road. Monthly management information on staff numbers and paybill costs in the Office of Rail Regulation. For workforce numbers, both payroll and non-payroll (contingent labour, including consultants) information is provided, split between full-time equivalents (FTE) and headcount, with payroll staff numbers mapped to standard Civil Service grades. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Office of Rail and Road. It offers 17 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2015-12-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
